description:
At Simple Technology Solutions, our people are our priority. We know our team members are more than employees—they’re parents, friends, volunteers, artists, and athletes. That’s why we offer flexibility to help them thrive personally and professionally while delivering exceptional solutions to our Federal Government clients. 

 Our culture is built on collaboration, continuous learning, and excellence. We are mentors and thought leaders who share knowledge and foster growth. Recognized as a “Best Place to Work,” we believe a range of perspectives helps us drive innovation and exceed customer expectations. At STS, taking care of our people isn’t a perk—it’s the standard. 

 As a HUBZone company, we also offer special incentives for team members living in qualified HUBZones. Check out the HUBZone map  HERE to see if you qualify! 

 Simple Technology Solutions is looking for an  AI Platform & DevSecOps Engineer to add to our team.

 Quick Position Overview: 

 
 US Citizenship and the ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance are required

 Bachelor's Degree is required

 Minimum of 8 years' position related experience is required

 AWS Solutions Architect (Associate) or DevOps Engineer (Professional) certification preferred for hire; the AWS and Anthropic Claude certifications listed under Required Certifications must be earned within 12 months of hire

 Remote position with occasional travel to client sites and STS events

 Candidates living in the DC Metro region (within driving distance for quarterly in-person team events) are strongly preferred; STS is a HUBZone company, so residence in a HUBZone is favored for remote candidates

 
 The Role: 

 The AI Platform & DevSecOps Engineer owns the environments, pipelines, and controls that let an STS AI team move fast safely in federal settings. You build and operate the standard DEV, TST, STG, and PRD environments with Terraform, automate the CI/CD gates that enforce the STS SDLC, and act as the team's release manager. Success looks like releases that are routine and boring, security and compliance evidence that is generated by the pipeline rather than assembled by hand, and AI services that are guarded, observable, and cost-controlled. Because many federal contracts ask for this skill set by name, you also support client engagements that run entirely on AWS-native services.

 The AI Platform & DevSecOps Engineer at STS will: 

 
 Design, build, and maintain the STS standard environment set (DEV and TST in a nonproduction account, STG and PRD in a production account) on AWS using Terraform and reusable infrastructure modules.

 Build and operate CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions or the client's equivalent that enforce the STS SDLC gates, including automated test execution, coverage thresholds, security scanning, and promotion approvals between environments.

 Serve as the team's release manager, orchestrating the release-management agents and skills, coordinating releases across environments, and maintaining release notes and rollback procedures.

 Secure AI workloads on AWS, including Amazon Bedrock guardrails, model access controls, IAM least-privilege design, data encryption, logging, and network isolation for sensitive data.

 Generate and maintain security and compliance evidence for federal frameworks such as FedRAMP, NIST 800-53, and CJIS, and support the client's ATO and continuous-monitoring processes.

 Implement observability for AI applications, including application and model-call tracing, evaluation metrics, cost monitoring, and alerting across all environments.

 Stand up and administer the team's AI development tooling, including Claude Code accounts and configuration, shared agent and skill repositories, and the connections between Jira, GitHub, and the pipelines.

 Provide AWS platform engineering on client engagements that run on AWS-native services, including landing zones, account structure, and well-architected reviews.

 Automate everything that sits between requirements and end-to-end testing, so that human effort concentrates on those two bookends of the lifecycle.

 Document the platform, runbooks, and standards as reusable parts of the STS SDLC, and coach engineers on using them.

 
 Education and Experience: 

 Required 

 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience in addition to the minimum below

 Minimum of 8 years of professional experience in DevOps, platform, cloud, or site-reliability engineering, including at least 4 years on AWS and at least 2 years supporting generative AI or machine-learning workloads

 Demonstrated experience delivering infrastructure as code with Terraform and CI/CD pipelines for a multi-environment application

 Experience supporting a federal or regulated system through an authorization process such as FedRAMP, RMF/ATO, or CJIS compliance

 Expert-level Terraform and AWS skills, including multi-account organization, IAM, VPC networking, KMS, CloudWatch, CloudTrail, and Security Hub

 Hands-on experience securing and operating Amazon Bedrock and related AI services, including guardrails, model access, and usage and cost controls

 Strong CI/CD skills with GitHub Actions (or equivalent), automated testing integration, container builds, and artifact and secrets management

 Working knowledge of Python or TypeScript sufficient to write automation, pipeline steps, and platform tooling

 Familiarity with Claude Code, agentic development tooling, and administering AI accounts and shared configuration for a team

 Security-minded by default while still optimizing for developer speed; treats friction in the pipeline as a bug

 Calm and methodical under release pressure, with strong attention to detail in evidence and change control

 Self-directed and comfortable owning outcomes on a small, senior team where everyone contributes across the lifecycle

 Curious and current on AI tooling; treats AI assistants as part of the team and holds their output to the same standard as human work

 Clear, candid communicator with federal clients and teammates; writes well and documents as a habit

 Bias toward fast delivery and early user feedback over conservative gating; learns from failure quickly

 
 Required Certifications (to be earned within 12 months of hire) 

 
 AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate or AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional

 Claude Certified Developer – Foundations (CCDV-F) or Claude Certified Associate – Foundations (CCAO-F)

 
 Preferred Certifications 

 
 AWS Certified Security – Specialty

 HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate

 CompTIA Security+ or CISSP

 Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)

 
  

 What We Offer: 

 
 Competitive compensation package

 Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance plans

 Professional development and training

 Performance-based incentives

 401(k) retirement savings plan

 Work from home stipend

 Unlimited PTO

 Paid holidays

 Flexible work schedule

 Professional development budget to be used for training and certifications

 STS is committed to equal employment opportunity and merit-based employment practices. STS provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination, harassment, and retaliation in all employment practices and decisions in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. 

 
 Employment decisions at STS are based on individual qualifications, performance, skills, and business needs, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, marital status, or any other status protected by applicable law. 

 
 This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, compensation, training, transfer, discipline, termination, layoff, recall, and leaves of absence. 

 --- 

 Applicants may request removal from our applicant database, or specific information about how the data is used by contacting recruiting@simpletechnology.io.
